actual: When a source issue PR is already merged and an earlier close-sync PR has already been merged, rerunning merge-finalizer can create another close-sync worktree/PR for the same BUG instead of recognizing the existing close-sync state and proceeding only to cleanup/reporting. The same flow can also treat a successful remote gh pr merge as failed when local checkout of main is blocked by the canonical root worktree.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
